item.description: The get_domain_separator function fails with TypeError: rjust() argument 2 must be a byte string of length 1, not str. The code attempts to call rjust(64, "0") on a bytes object but passes a string "0" instead of b"0". This is a type mismatch in the padding operation.
item.contract: Fix the type handling in the verifyingContract padding section to properly convert the address to bytes before applying the padding operation. The function should correctly handle the conversion from address string to 32-byte hex representation.

item.description: The spec module references undefined types spec.Domain and spec.Hash that are used in function signatures but not defined in the typedefs module. This creates import errors and prevents proper type checking.
item.contract: Add the missing Domain and Hash type definitions to the spec typedefs module to support proper type annotations throughout the codebase.
item.acceptance: Importing and using spec.Domain and spec.Hash in function signatures should work without errors

item.description: The transaction signing logic has inconsistent field mappings between different Ethereum transaction formats, particularly for legacy vs EIP-1559 transactions. The function handles some field renamings but not others, causing mismatches in expected transaction data.
item.contract: Standardize field name handling in transaction serialization to consistently map field names across different transaction types, ensuring uniform behavior regardless of transaction format.

item.description: CLI command execution failures occur due to command execution issues in the CLI subsystem. The subprocess calls in the CLI tests are failing with exit codes, indicating problems with command resolution or execution environment setup.
item.contract: Improve error handling and command execution reliability in CLI commands to ensure consistent execution of subcommands and their examples.
